_comment: Applied to a tenant pod's indexing container only (crates/wkp-hub/src/tenant_pod.rs, issue #159) via `podman run --security-opt seccomp=...`. Default-allow, explicit-deny on every syscall that could create or use a network socket -- verified by hand against real podman (a sibling container in the same pod, with an unrestricted listener, could no longer even call socket() once this profile was applied: 'nc: socket: Operation not permitted'). Kept as a deny-list rather than a full allow-list profile: an allow-list is fragile across libc/kernel versions for a filesystem-and-SQLite-only process, and this needs to comprehensively block one specific capability (networking), not minimize the whole syscall surface.
